description: Four voices, and not a scene yet

participation.context: Hummed, lost the phrase, and cut the list in two.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.quote: Four voices, and not one of them telling the others what it means.

story.body: You tried the four parts and could not hold them. You called them a scene that was not ready. Then you divided the month and struck the half that was only improvement.

relations.quote: Four voices, and not one of them telling the others what it means.

title: Hummed the anthem and struck half the list

participation.context: Wrote both halves and struck the second.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: Thursday carries what is already written
the letter of the 16th waits, unrevised

story.body: You kept Saturday, Thursday's copy, the three nights, the 16th, and the carrier. You put the pack and the 60s on the 18th and the 20s on the 22nd, and you paid nothing. You struck another page, ten lines in the vault, and a finished wood-play. You did not rewrite the six lines.

relations.note: Thursday carries what is already written
the letter of the 16th waits, unrevised

title: Wrote the month's work and struck the rest

participation.context: Counted, and wrote the line once.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the list is shut; dinner is already eaten

story.body: You counted the days to the 26th and entered one line. The line is Richmond, twenty-six days. Nothing else was added on that leaf.

relations.note: the list is shut; dinner is already eaten

title: Wrote twenty-six days against St Stephen
